entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: I presume you have grown stronger[n]since your last attempt.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: As before, I will prepare an[n]appropriate venue within Mementos.[n]Come with me.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Now then... do not disappoint us!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: We promised to gain your consent.[n]If you do not wish to fight, we will[n]not force it upon you.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: However, please report back to us[n]if you happen to change your mind.
